page.content:
1986 short whose hopping lamp became the studio mark.

How Luxo Jr. connects

  • Creator: John Lasseter — Lasseter directed Luxo Jr.
  • Topic: Pixar — Luxo Jr. is the short that became Pixar's mark.
  • Topic: Pixar — The Luxo lamp inspired Pixar's bouncing studio mark.

What is Luxo Jr.?

Luxo Jr. is Lasseter's short about a parent lamp and child lamp; the little lamp became Pixar's ident, bouncing onto the letter I before every feature.

Key threads lead to John Lasseter, Pixar and Pixar.
